user_stories.benefit: to reduce manual onboarding time from five business days to under one business day
to enable seamless payment processing for new clients
to provide users with a clear, real‑time view of their onboarding progress
to eliminate manual review and speed up onboarding
to make the onboarding experience usable for all users, including those with disabilities

risk_register.description: Delay in receiving production API credentials from the third‑party payment vendor, blocking backend integration and threatening the release date.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Escalate vendor delay to account manager, request expedited credentials, and prepare a contingency plan for alternative credentials.

risk_register.description: Chosen UI component library may not satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements, potentially requiring rework of the onboarding dashboard.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Conduct an early accessibility audit of the library; if non‑compliant, select an alternative library or implement custom components.

risk_register.description: Staging environment instability blocked QA regression testing for multiple days, delaying verification of new features.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Set up monitoring and alerting for staging, file an infrastructure ticket, and consider using a temporary stable test environment.

risk_register.description: Automated KYC document verification rejects valid government ID uploads due to image compression, blocking end‑to‑end onboarding.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Investigate the compression algorithm, adjust quality settings, add a manual review fallback, and re‑run verification tests.

risk_register.description: Load testing on the payment flow has not yet been conducted, leaving performance risks unvalidated.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Schedule load testing early, define performance benchmarks, and address bottlenecks before release.

risk_register.description: Backend integration remains behind schedule, increasing the risk of missing the end‑of‑month release.
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Allocate additional resources, prioritize integration tasks, monitor progress daily, and adjust the release plan if necessary.
